summary: The pulse condition detects a high level held across cycles rather than a rising edge.
reasoning: The reference expects enable && signal_in && !previous_ref at tb/pulse_tb.v:11. After reset, previous is zero, so the first enabled high input should produce a pulse; the baseline instead produced zero. Negating previous aligns the RTL with the reference. This is strongly supported, though the proposed patch has not been independently validated.
